mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_guide_progress (workspace_id, user_id, status, stage, substep, version, creator_id, modifier_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{substep}, 0, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, user_id, status, stage, substep, conversation_id, client_message_id, version, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id FROM workspace_guide_progress WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_guide_progress SET status = #{status}, stage = #{stage}, substep = #{substep}, conversation_id = #{conversationId}, client_message_id = #{clientMessageId}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
